Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an original DEVICE PLANET game-visualization concept for DreamMate's capability universe. The user has explicitly changed the mapping: ONE DEVICE IS ONE ROUND PLANET. This is not a spacecraft or a spherical space station. The art direction belongs to the same family as clean white/graphite/orange/cyan industrial science-fiction assets, with the optimistic planetary scale and clarity associated with Dyson Sphere Program, but original. Render a fully round, easily readable celestial sphere, semi-realistic stylized real-time game PBR quality, distant strategic-view camera, complete circle comfortably framed with safe margin. Deep blue-grey planetary surface, muted mineral landmasses, subtle off-white engineered districts, restrained safety orange markers and cyan energy nodes. Manufactured detail is very small at planetary scale; the overall form must read first as a planet, not a giant mechanical ball. One isolated planet only on genuinely transparent RGBA background. No outer space backdrop, star field, orbit diagrams, UI, text, names, labels, watermark, rings around the planet, surrounding ships or other planets. Planet's body is opaque; atmospheric glow may be translucent. Soft directional illumination from upper left, clean volume and controlled bloom.
Subject: the central HUB WORLD, a concept for the current Mac as the network's main visual center. An established, well-developed world with several small interconnected industrial districts and calm cyan network lights on the night side. Large stable calm sphere, warm gold/orange atmospheric corona and a restrained sun-like halo convey the idea of a network's visual sun while keeping its planetary surface fully visible. Not a fiery burning star, not lava, no weapons. Keep atmosphere elegant and thin, not overexposed. Visually communicates a developed central hub through density, cohesion and gentle warm rim light.
